subject.title: fix(reef): keep routine agent replies from disappearing

question: Should an approved Reef peer be allowed by default to send ordinary task imperatives such as edit, test, investigate, or report into the receiving agent session?
rationale: This changes Reef's prompt-injection boundary rather than only repairing delivery feedback, so tests cannot establish whether the broader signed-peer authority matches the intended product trust model.

options.title: Allow bounded peer tasks
options.body: Accept ordinary task requests from approved signed peers, but require lifecycle cancellation and adversarial live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep stricter steering review
options.body: Retain review or denial for task imperatives while landing only the sender-visible signed rejection and durable recovery portions.

recommendation.title: Allow bounded peer tasks
recommendation.body: Accept ordinary task requests from approved signed peers, but require lifecycle cancellation and adversarial live proof before merge.
